theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Technology (+1.29%) and Energy (-0.26%) led the market today, while Consumer Staples (-1.21%) and Industrials (-1.14%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.30%, defensives -1.01%, and value/cyclicals -0.80% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. That shows up at the index level too: the tech-heavy Nasdaq gained +1.57% while the blue-chip Dow lagged at +0.20%. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at +0.28%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX fell 4.60% to 14.51, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold slipped 0.52% to $4,654.80, crude oil was little changed at $83.54, and bitcoin gained 1.34% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
